lines: My catch needs storage before I cast again.
I cannot carry more fish, and there is nowhere nearby to put them.
I need a fishing rod before I can work the water.
I am fetching a fishing rod from assigned storage.
The line is in the water. Now I am waiting for a bite.
I am looking along the bank for a good place to cast.
There is no fishable surface water within casting range of my work area.
I can see fishable water, but I cannot reach a safe place to cast from.
I am moving to the water now.
I cast the line. Now we see what answers.
I reeled in the catch and stored it.
I reeled in the catch, but some of it had to be dropped because storage was full.
